# QC Spec Quality Checklist: XOmni Password Login QC

**Purpose**: Review whether the feature specification (and linked QC plan artifacts) is complete, clear, testable, and traceable. This checklist evaluates **requirements writing**. It does **not** exercise the XOmni website.
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are all in-scope password-login capabilities documented as numbered requirements (REQ-LOGIN-001 through REQ-LOGIN-005)? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [X] CHK002 Does every stated user need (view login, succeed with valid credentials, reject invalid password, require Email, require Password) have a matching requirement? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [X] CHK003 Are out-of-scope authentication methods listed so they are not silently treated as missing requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [X] CHK004 Is the immutable-SUT constraint documented so QC work is not specified as product change? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution I]

## Acceptance Criteria Clarity

- [X] CHK005 Are the four required login-page labels in AC-LOGIN-001 named exactly (Đăng nhập, Email, Mật khẩu, Tiếp tục) rather than vaguely as “the form”? [Clarity, Spec §AC-LOGIN-001]
- [X] CHK006 Is “left the login page” defined without implying an unspecified destination screen? [Clarity, Spec §AC-LOGIN-002, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK007 Is the error oracle for AC-LOGIN-003 limited to visible status/message and explicitly **not** exact copy? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §AC-LOGIN-003]
- [X] CHK008 Is “validation message for Email” vs “for Password” distinguished so the two required-field ACs are not interchangeable? [Clarity, Spec §AC-LOGIN-004, Spec §AC-LOGIN-005]
- [X] CHK009 Is “submit the login form” related unambiguously to “Tiếp tục” where both phrases appear? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Testability

- [X] CHK010 Can AC-LOGIN-001 be judged pass/fail solely from presence of the four named UI elements? [Measurability, Spec §AC-LOGIN-001, Spec §SC-001]
- [X] CHK011 Can AC-LOGIN-002 be judged pass/fail from leaving the login page without a named post-login screen? [Measurability, Spec §AC-LOGIN-002, Spec §SC-002]
- [X] CHK012 Can AC-LOGIN-003 be judged pass/fail from failed login plus **visible** error without string equality? [Measurability, Spec §AC-LOGIN-003, Spec §SC-003]
- [X] CHK013 Can AC-LOGIN-004 and AC-LOGIN-005 be judged pass/fail from failed login plus a field-associated validation indication without prescribed wording? [Measurability, Spec §AC-LOGIN-004, Spec §AC-LOGIN-005]
- [X] CHK014 Do Success Criteria SC-001 through SC-005 use observable outcomes aligned to those ACs (not implementation tooling)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Measurable Outcomes]

## Traceability (Requirement → Acceptance Criteria)

- [X] CHK015 Does the spec mapping table pair each REQ-LOGIN-00N to exactly one AC-LOGIN-00N with no orphan IDs? [Traceability, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [X] CHK016 Is each acceptance scenario labeled with its AC ID so reviewers can reverse-lookup from story to requirement? [Traceability, Spec §User Stories]
- [X] CHK017 Are Test Case IDs (TC-LOGIN-001..005) specified to bind REQ and AC for automation without inventing extra cases? [Traceability, Plan §Scale/Scope, contracts/traceability.md]
- [X] CHK018 Would adding a test without both a Requirement ID and an Acceptance Criteria ID violate documented quality gates? [Traceability, Constitution V]

## Positive Cases

- [X] CHK019 Are positive (happy-path) requirements complete for unauthenticated display of the login page? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, REQ-LOGIN-001]
- [X] CHK020 Are positive requirements complete for successful password login with valid email and password? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, REQ-LOGIN-002]
- [X] CHK021 Is the positive path limited to password login (no implied SSO/OTP success criteria)? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Negative Cases

- [X] CHK022 Are negative requirements defined for valid email with invalid password? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, AC-LOGIN-003]
- [X] CHK023 Does REQ-LOGIN-003’s “invalid credentials / no app access” stay scoped to that password-failure case rather than unspecified extra negatives? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK024 Are unspecified negatives (lockout, wrong-email-only, rate limit) documented as **not** required rather than left ambiguous? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Validation Cases

- [X] CHK025 Are required-field validation requirements defined for empty Email? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, REQ-LOGIN-004]
- [X] CHK026 Are required-field validation requirements defined for empty Password? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5, REQ-LOGIN-005]
- [X] CHK027 Is simultaneous empty Email and empty Password intentionally excluded from required validation coverage? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK028 Do validation ACs require a visible indication without prescribing copy, consistent with the error-copy clarification? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions]

## Scope Boundaries

- [X] CHK029 Are OTP, Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Apple, registration, and forgot-password explicitly out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [X] CHK030 Does SC-006 forbid using unspecified UI behavior as an oracle? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, Constitution XII]
- [X] CHK031 Is modifying the XOmni application excluded from this QC specification? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution I]

## Automation Feasibility (of the written spec)

- [X] CHK032 Are all in-scope ACs observable from the public UI without SUT code changes? [Feasibility, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution I]
- [X] CHK033 Are locatable UI names specified well enough to choose locators without inventing extra labels? [Feasibility, Spec §AC-LOGIN-001]
- [X] CHK034 Is the remaining automation risk (unnamed error/validation copy, unnamed post-login screen) acknowledged in the spec rather than hidden? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK035 Does the spec avoid mandating `time.sleep` or other non-spec wait rules as product requirements? [Consistency, Constitution VII]

## Credential Security (in the specification)

- [X] CHK036 Does the spec keep valid credentials out of the document and defer them to environment configuration? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution VI]
- [X] CHK037 Are the required environment variable **names** specified without example secret **values**? [Clarity, Plan §Constraints, config/.env.example]
- [X] CHK038 Is hard-coding credentials forbidden as a QC requirement, not merely a coding preference? [Consistency, Constitution VI]

## Test Independence (in the specification / plan)

- [X] CHK039 Is each user story described as independently testable without depending on another story’s leftover session? [Coverage, Spec §Independent Test]
- [X] CHK040 Does QC governance require tests to be order-independent and repeatable (fresh session, no shared leftover auth)? [Completeness, Constitution IX, Plan §Isolation]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Reviewer is evaluating `spec.md` (and plan/contracts only where items cite them), not executing XOmni
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
